availability.reason: Gemini API terms require API clients to be made available only within Google's published available regions.

description: Google's Gemini API for multimodal generation, embeddings, TTS, images, music, Veo video, realtime, and native batch processing. Google Search grounding is intentionally not exposed through Phaseo because the applicable Google terms are incompatible with Phaseo's gateway offering.
residency_notes: Google's Gemini API terms do not provide a customer-selected inference region. Paid services can achieve a zero-data footprint only by following the documented controls and avoiding retention features; prompts and responses may otherwise be stored transiently or cached in any country where Google or its agents maintain facilities.
prompt_training_notes: Google says unpaid Google AI Studio and unpaid Gemini API quota may be used to improve and develop Google products, and human reviewers may process inputs and outputs. Paid services are not used to improve products once Cloud Billing is active, but prompts and responses may still be logged for safety for a limited period and transiently stored or cached in any country.

sources.notes: Current Gemini, embedding, TTS, image, Veo, and Lyria model families.
Native asynchronous generateContent and embedding batch contracts, files, lifecycle, webhooks, and 50% pricing.
Google Search grounding is not offered through the Phaseo gateway due to provider-policy and legal constraints. Do not infer gateway support from Google's public model capability or pricing tables.

verification.notes: Text, embeddings, images, TTS, music, video, safety behavior, and Batch surfaces checked against current first-party references.
